expectations.text: 通用筛选触发器、选项与确认入口具有可访问的控件语义和名称，并保留 tap/遮罩触摸链路；带可见文本的原生 button 不要求重复添加 aria-role/aria-label，非原生可点击节点使用 aria-role
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.mpx:2 trigger uses aria-role="button" and aria-label="筛选" with bindtap="open"; outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.mpx:6 options are clickable <view wx:for ... bindtap="toggle(item.value)">{{item.label}}</view> but lack aria-role/control semantics. outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.mpx:7-8 confirm/clear are native button text controls, and mask bindtap/dialog bindtap stop preserve touch chain.

expectations.text: 完整浏览器 role=dialog、aria-modal、tabindex 与键盘事件只存在于 Web 文件或 Web-only 模板逻辑
expectations.evidence: Browser dialog semantics and keyboard handling are confined to outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:4-5 role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1" and outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:41 document.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKeydown). The common outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.mpx has no tabindex or keyboard event, only mini-style aria-role="dialog".

expectations.text: Web 打开前记录真实触发元素，渲染完成后把焦点移入弹层；关闭后仅在元素仍连接文档时恢复焦点
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:23-27 records document.activeElement before setting visible, falling back to this.$refs.trigger; lines 30-34 focus this.$refs.dialog after $nextTick; lines 51-55 restore focus only when trigger.isConnected and focus is a function.

expectations.text: Escape 关闭弹层；Tab 与 Shift+Tab 在当前弹层的可聚焦元素首尾循环，遮罩点击不误触内容区
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:63-68 handles Escape with preventDefault and close(); lines 69-91 trap Tab/Shift+Tab by cycling first/last focusable elements and refocusing when focus is outside. outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:4 closes on mask click, while line 5 uses @click.stop on dialog content.

expectations.text: document/window 键盘或焦点监听在每次关闭和 detached/unmounted 时成对移除，快速开关不会重复注册
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:36-44 guards document keydown registration with keyboardListening to avoid duplicates; lines 46-49 remove the listener and reset the flag; line 38 removes on close and lines 17-20 remove again during detached, making cleanup paired and idempotent.

expectations.text: 选项选择、清空、确认、取消、焦点恢复和微信小程序触摸业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.mpx:2-8 keeps bindtap open, mask close, dialog stop, option toggle, clear and confirm for mini touch. outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.mpx:19-29 keeps toggle deselect/reselect, clear, confirm event with selected payload and close. outputs/src/components/filter-dialog.web.mpx:32-39 closes with focus restoration path, and lines 57-61 keep toggle, clear, confirm event and close.

suggestions: c2 does not explicitly require using the click event/currentTarget as the trigger source, so an implementation based on document.activeElement can pass even though pointer focus timing may vary by browser.
c5 mentions cancel but the component has no explicit cancel control; the assertion should define whether mask/Escape close counts as cancel.
eval_feedback.overall: 主要 Web 键盘、焦点恢复和监听清理实现完整；失败点是通用模板的非原生选项仍缺少可访问控件语义。
